description: E01 retrieval evaluation set: 60 English developer questions (20 calibration, 40 held-out) over docs/sources. Questions are rewritten from maintainer questions and public Q&A (source URL recorded); never copied verbatim.

questions.text: What's the difference between the ChainSync and BlockFetch mini-protocols? Can a node serve old blocks over BlockFetch but not over ChainSync, and what does a client need in order to sync from genesis over node-to-node?
Can a node bootstrapped from a Mithril snapshot continue syncing over ChainSync from that point? Does a Mithril Cardano DB snapshot contain the ledger state or only the immutable chain files?
What does "error connecting bearer" mean when a client tries to connect to the cardano-node local socket (for example, for local tx-monitor or mempool access)?
How is the minimum ADA for a UTxO calculated (coinsPerUTxOByte), and how does it grow with native assets, datums and reference scripts? Is "min ADA" the same as the ledger's min-UTxO value?
How can a Plutus or Aiken validator know the current time? How is the transaction validity interval used as a time source, for example for time-dependent interest?
What is the "withdraw zero" pattern, and how does a spending or minting validator require a particular staking script to witness the transaction?
Does CIP-30 let a dApp ask the wallet for only its reward (stake) address? What do getRewardAddresses and getBalance return, and does the balance include staked or locked funds?
In CIP-8 / CIP-30 signData, what does the "hashed" option do? Do hardware wallets such as Ledger require hashed payloads?
Can a node-to-node peer (for example one built with Yaci) serve the mempool or tx-submission protocol without holding the full chain history, and what does it need for the handshake and ChainSync?
I'm trying to raise maxTxExMem on a Yaci DevKit devnet, but editing node.properties or the Alonzo genesis template changes nothing. How are protocol parameters meant to be customised on a devnet?
The leadership schedule says my pool should have forged in a slot, and the logs show it forged, but the block never made it on chain. What should I check?
After upgrading cardano-node from 10.4 to 10.5, the KES metrics I used to alert on (remaining KES periods, opcert expiry) are gone from the Prometheus endpoint. Where did they go?
How is the hash of a stake pool metadata JSON file computed for the registration certificate, and does whitespace in the file matter?

I signed a message with the Ledger Cardano app (signMessage, unhashed payload) and got back a signature and public key. How can I verify that signature off-chain, with cardano-serialization-lib or another library?
I build a delegation transaction with cardano-serialization-lib, and add_change_if_needed sometimes puts the whole leftover of a 7 ADA input into the fee instead of returning change. Why?
Spending a UTxO locked at a Plutus V3 script with MeshTxBuilder fails at submission with an "Extraneous scripts" error. What makes a script extraneous, and how should the spend be built?
Can an Aiken Int ever overflow or underflow, or should I add bounds checks for arithmetic in my validator?
Once a governance action is on chain, how long can it be voted on before it expires, and what sets that limit?
What format does MeshTxBuilder expect for txInDatumValue and txInRedeemerValue? My unlock transaction fails when I pass the datum as JSON.
My cardano-node 10.5 on preprod, with the official config files, stalls at an early Byron block with no errors in the log. What could keep it from syncing?

If a Plutus transaction's script integrity hash (script_data_hash) doesn't match the cost models in the current protocol parameters, is it rejected in phase 1, or does the submitter lose collateral? Does this differ between node implementations' mempools?
Do Ogmios and Kupo need a node-to-client (local socket) connection to a Haskell cardano-node, or can they work over node-to-node, or against other node implementations?
Can Kupo be bootstrapped or fed from Ogmios instead of directly from the node socket?
What are the options for submitting a transaction to Cardano (local tx-submission over N2C, Ogmios, cardano-submit-api, Blockfrost), and what are the trade-offs?

What does a self-hosted Blockfrost backend (blockfrost-platform, the former Icebreaker programme) need from the node: only a node-to-node connection, or also node-to-client to a Haskell node? Can it bootstrap from Mithril?
Does Blockfrost expose an endpoint to check how many API requests have been used or remain in the current quota?
Why does Blockfrost's transaction evaluation endpoint return "failed to decode payload from base64 or base16", and what body format does it expect?
Do JavaScript/TypeScript Cardano SDKs automatically top up outputs to the minimum ADA, as cardano-client-lib's transaction builder does?

Does cardano-client-lib support chaining transactions, i.e. spending outputs of a transaction that isn't confirmed yet as inputs of the next one, or do you have to wait for each transaction to be on chain?
How does the account index in CIP-1852 derivation give independent wallets from one mnemonic, and how do you select it in cardano-client-lib?
What is the SlotConfig (zero time, zero slot, slot length) needed for off-chain Plutus script evaluation, and how do you get it for mainnet, preprod and preview?
Can several pending transactions use the same collateral UTxO? What happens to the others when one of them is included in a block?
If several transactions spending the same UTxO are submitted at once, how do the mempool and the ledger handle the conflict, and what does the losing submitter see?
What's the difference between reference inputs (CIP-31) and reference scripts (CIP-33), and when would a transaction use each?
How do you get an Aiken validator's script hash from plutus.json (the CIP-57 blueprint), and how do parameters change it?
In Aiken, can an opaque type be used as a datum or redeemer, or only as a parameter?
Under Conway, does registering a script stake credential need the script to witness the registration certificate (with a deposit), and how did that differ before Conway?

When a hardware wallet signs a Cardano transaction, can it change the serialized body and so the transaction hash? What does CIP-21 require of transactions meant for hardware wallets, especially minting transactions?
How can an indexer detect when a Conway governance action is enacted? Which ledger events or state changes mark ratification and enactment?
How long does a Cardano transaction usually take to appear on chain, and how should a dApp poll for confirmation (for example by transaction hash through Blockfrost)?
How do you find which UTxO holds a given reference script (by script hash) through Blockfrost or Koios?
Can Yaci DevKit produce blocks faster than once per second, for example every 0.5 s, and which option sets the block time?
Is there a way to force a rollback on a Yaci DevKit devnet, from the CLI or through config, so I can test how my indexer handles it?
My mainnet relay on cardano-node 8.9 stopped syncing at the start of September 2024 and sits at the last Babbage slot. Do old node versions stop working at a hard fork, and which version do I need?
cardano-cli query leadership-schedule used to work every epoch, but now it fails decoding the Conway epoch state with "expected word16". What causes that?

I don't want rewards for the epoch in which I deregister my stake address to be lost. If I deregister in epoch n, do I still get the epoch-n rewards, and does my stake still count in the next snapshot?
With cardano-client-lib, can one transfer spend UTxOs that sit at several different addresses of the same wallet? The examples only show a single sender.
How do I build and sign a vote-delegation certificate to the always-abstain option with cardano-client-lib?
CIP-30 getUsedAddresses gives me hex-encoded address bytes. How do I turn those into something I can match against tx_out in cardano-db-sync, ideally inside a Postgres query?
In an Aiken spending validator, how do I find the input that is being validated, and does the validator run once per script input or once per transaction?
After years of working Lucid code, every transaction now fails with "CostModel operation 166 out of bounds. Max is 166". What changed on the network?
I poll Kupo's /matches with ETag / If-None-Match. After a rollback a UTxO it returned earlier is simply missing. How is a client meant to detect and handle rolled-back matches?
Hydra's /commit makes me commit a whole UTxO. If I only want 50 ADA of a 300 ADA UTxO with tokens in the head, do I have to split it first in a separate transaction?
Is there a recognised way to embed a file in a CIP-25 NFT's metadata so that generic explorers and wallets offer it for viewing or download, and can a tiny image be stored inline as the NFT image?
Implementing a SNARK verifier in Aiken, carrying G1/G2 BLS points in tuples or custom types costs far more CPU than using them directly. Why, and how should points be passed around?
Besides the Haskell cardano-node, what other implementations of the Cardano node and protocol exist or are in development?
Why is TxId represented differently in the Plutus V1 and V3 ledger API types, and what does that change for code that hashes or serialises a TxOutRef?
Both the Plutus Playground and the Marlowe Playground seem to be offline. Are they being maintained, and is there a replacement for trying contracts in the browser?
Sweeping ADA from an old Byron paper wallet (Ae2... address) with Exodus fails with "Digest not supported". What is that error, and how else can I move the funds?

On Ogmios 6.14.0.1 with cardano-node 11.0.1, evaluateTransaction rejects a Babbage-format transaction as being from an unsupported era. Is that expected, and must the transaction be re-encoded as Conway?

status: draft: answer locations agent-labelled and cross-reviewed; maintainer expert review pending; not yet a release gate
